comparison.objective: Place caplets in the correct pill-organizer cells and snap every lid shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold down a light organizer while lifting small catches, placing pills, and re-latching lids.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one caplet in Monday and Thursday, no dosing errors, all lids snapped, organizer released and stable.
comparison.reason: Tests small-lid unlatching, placement, and snapping; it has no adjustable stop, coupled screw/nut locking, or setting-retention verification.
